details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:211,537 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When two or more versions are set, they are joined with `_` (`IFS=_`) and passed as the `SANDBOX_SOLC_VERSIONS` build arg; the reviewers say the build-arg regex at scripts/sandbox_image.sh:87 (`^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*=[A-Za-z0-9._@+-]*$`) rejects that value, so sandbox_image.sh exits 2 and the opted-in build fails.
  WHY: Reviewers disagree on severity: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated it MAJOR and minimax_minimax-m3 rated it BLOCKER (the tests at tests/test_codex_isolated_exec.py:860/:898 would raise CalledProcessError); this ledger uses the highest. The finding is also disputed: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash checked the code and say the value class `[A-Za-z0-9._@+-]` does include `_`, so `SANDBOX_SOLC_VERSIONS=0.8.24_0.8.20` passes. They call it a false positive.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:297 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: After a redirect, the generated solc_install.py `fetch()` checks only that the URL starts with `https://` and never checks the host, so list.json (which supplies the expected sha256 values) and the binaries could come from any HTTPS host.
  WHY: This breaks the checksum trust chain at image-build time on every opted-in run (MAJOR). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:352-389,407,427-434,563 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The generated installer exits 1 on `unknown_version` (a well-formed version that does not exist, e.g. `0.8.99`), on `unsupported_arch` (a runner that is not x86_64), or on a fetch failure. This fails the image build, and `build_image` ends in `unavailable image_build_failed`.
  WHY: Every isolated call in an opted-in repo (prepare, run, the pre-push gate `image`) then fails until the variable is cleared, which contradicts the issue's "must never fail the run" warn-and-skip fallback. All four reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:536-544 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Opted-in image hashes are never published to GHCR, so every call first makes a `docker pull` that is bound to fail (scripts/sandbox_image.sh:143-149) before falling back to a local build.
  WHY: This adds latency, capped by `SANDBOX_IMAGE_PULL_TIMEOUT_SECS`, but behaviour stays correct (NIT). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 considers this the documented, acceptable fallback and not a defect.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:512-513 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The generated Dockerfile runs solc_install.py as root during the image build.
  WHY: Running as root widens the blast radius if the installer or the binary is compromised, even though the step is gated and checksum-verified (NIT).
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:190-193 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: A non-empty value made only of separators (e.g. `,,,`) normalises to no tokens and returns without the required invalid-value warning.
  WHY: The image is built without solc and nothing tells the user that the configured value was malformed (NIT).
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:367-371,395-397 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: An OSError from `write_atomic`/`link_atomic` is caught by the generic `except (OSError, ValueError)` and logged as `outcome=fetch_failed`.
  WHY: The build still fails as intended, but the log points operators at a network fetch problem instead of a disk or link failure (NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "After editing, check `wc -c .github/workflows/implement.yml`. If it is at or above 480,000 bytes, apply unattended §24 in this PR."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/implement.yml (size check recorded in the PR description / acceptance section)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR makes .github/workflows/implement.yml larger (by 6 lines; the file is now 7,368 lines), but the PR context and the pre-push-gate and acceptance sections record no `wc -c` measurement. tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py is in the inherited-failure list on both base and head, so nobody can confirm the 480,000-byte guard was checked.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:generated solc_install.py `install()`/`main()`; build_image() line 563; unavailable() lines 427-434 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A well-formed but non-existent version (e.g. `0.8.99`), an arm64 runner, or a soliditylang.org outage makes the image build exit 1, and `build_image` then fails hard.
  WHY: Every isolated call in an opted-in repo fails (prepare via implement.yml lines 3532 and 4783, run, and the gate `image` call at scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:888). The issue says an invalid value "must never fail the run"; only a checksum mismatch should fail the build.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION (2 related items): (1) in solc_install.py `fetch()`, after a redirect check that `urllib.parse.urlsplit(response.geturl()).hostname == "binaries.soliditylang.org"` and not just the scheme (about 3 lines); (2) have `sandbox_solc_resolve_versions` warn and drop solc when `uname -m` is not x86_64, keeping checksum failures fatal (about 4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- NOTE: Rejects the `_` build-arg finding as a false positive, because the value class at scripts/sandbox_image.sh:87 includes `_`.
- NOTE: The failures in tests/test_agents_fragment_contract.py::test_instructions_point_at_fragments and tests/test_changelog_fragment_contract.py come from files this PR does not touch. The copilot-pull-request-reviewer check failure is `custom_instructions_too_large` (HTTP 422), an external configuration error.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE (all issue #9171 deliverables are present).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:211 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Joining multiple versions with `_` (`IFS=_`) produces a build-arg value that the regex in scripts/sandbox_image.sh rejects.
  WHY: The reviewer says the regex `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*=[A-Za-z0-9._@+-]*$` does not include `_`, so any setup with more than one version fails at the image build/prepare step.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:563 (in build_image() calling the generated solc_install.py) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The installer exits 1 and fails the image build on a runner that is not x86_64 or when a version is unknown upstream.
  WHY: All isolated implement actions (prepare, run, gate image) fail for the opted-in repo; falling back to a build without solc plus a warning would be more robust.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:536-544 (in build_image() calling sandbox_image.sh) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Every opted-in image build first tries a GHCR `docker pull` that is bound to fail before the local build.
  WHY: This adds latency and confusion to every isolated call, although the result is still correct.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:512-513 (generated Dockerfile lines) | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: solc_install.py runs as root during the Dockerfile build.
  WHY: This widens the blast radius if the binary or the installer logic is compromised.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  Requirement: "If [implement.yml] is at or above 480,000 bytes, apply unattended §24 in this PR." (which implicitly requires a measurement check).
  Expected change site: implement.yml growth assessment.
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff makes .github/workflows/implement.yml larger, but there is no evidence of a wc -c measurement or confirmation in the PR context that the file remains below the guard threshold.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh (generated solc_install.py, fetch() function), line 389. After a redirect, also check that the hostname is binaries.soliditylang.org (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh (generated solc_install.py inside `write_image_context`):line 297 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: After a redirect only the URL scheme is checked, not the host, so list.json and the binaries can be redirected to an attacker-controlled HTTPS host whose sha256 values match the attacker's binaries.
  WHY: This is the trust boundary for the whole solc install, and it is reached at image-build time on every opted-in run.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:line 211 and line 537 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Two or more versions joined with `_` are forwarded as a `--build-arg`; the reviewer says `scripts/sandbox_image.sh:87`'s value class `[A-Za-z0-9._@+-]` excludes `_`, so the script emits `::error::SANDBOX_IMAGE invalid --build-arg` and exits 2.
  WHY: The tests at `tests/test_codex_isolated_exec.py:860` and `:898` would raise CalledProcessError, and real opted-in implement runs would fail. The feature is documented as supporting "up to 5 versions", but only one version works.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh (generated solc_install.py, `main()`):lines 387-389, line 354, line 407 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The installer exits 1 on a runner that is not x86_64 or for a valid-looking version missing from `linux-amd64/list.json`, which fails the whole image build.
  WHY: Every opted-in implement call ends in `unavailable image_build_failed`, which is harsher than the warn-and-skip path for values with an invalid format.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION (2 related items): (1) line 297: require the redirected URL to start with `https://binaries.soliditylang.org/` (1 line); (2) lines 387-389: log `outcome=skip` and `return 0` instead of `return 1` (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 4
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE (all issue #9171 deliverables are present).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:190-193 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A non-empty value made only of separators, such as `,,,`, normalises to no tokens and returns without the required invalid-value warning.
  WHY: The image is built without solc, but the workflow gives no warning that the configured value was malformed.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:generated solc_install.py `main()` lines 387-389 and `install()` lines 352-354; `build_image()` line 563 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A well-formed but non-existent version (e.g. `0.8.99`) passes host-side validation and only fails with `unknown_version` during the docker build; `unsupported_arch` fails the same way.
  WHY: `build_image` returns `unavailable image_build_failed`, which fails codex implement runs; the claude engine degrades to exit 75 again and again.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:`install()` write loop lines 367-371; `main()` lines 395-397 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: An OSError from `write_atomic`/`link_atomic` is logged with the misleading outcome `fetch_failed`.
  WHY: Behaviour is correct, but the `outcome=fetch_failed reason=-` log for a local write error misleads operators.
- scripts/codex_isolated_exec.sh:`build_image()` lines 536-544 with scripts/sandbox_image.sh:143-149 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Opted-in hashes are never publish
